Methodology: Figures are computed from the raw "mCaffeine" tab of the Master KYC Raw Dump workbook. Rows flagged "Duplicate" in the sheet's own dedup column are excluded from all per-class drill-downs (Overview tab shows both). "Ticket Month" is derived from ticket creation date; "Order Month" is derived from the underlying order date and can lag or lead the ticket month. Where a dimension was blank for a ticket, it is shown as "(blank)" and included in totals unless noted otherwise.

Report Generated 09 Jul 2026 from live sheet data. No raw ticket-level data (which includes customer PII) is stored in this report — all figures are aggregated segment counts.
